items.question: Which adornment completes the linga's sleeping-standing band measured by fingers?
items.inference: The verse states that the sleeping-standing band is adorned by finger-measures.
uncertainties: Exact referent of the adorned object is not explicit in this verse.
items.plain_english: It is adorned with the sleeping-standing band by fingers and the like.
